---
name: Something doesn't work
about: A bug, a crash, or the wheel misbehaving somewhere
---

**What happened, and what did you expect?**


**Where?** The app or website you were in, if it matters.


**Version:** right-click the tray icon, it's next to *About*. On Linux, the release you downloaded.

**System:** Windows 10 or 11 (or your Linux distro), and your display scaling if you use more than one monitor.

**Settings:** paste `%APPDATA%\DontForget\settings.ini` (or `~/.config/dont-forget/settings.ini`) if you changed anything.
